dedupe_keys.name: temoaproject using robust optimization techniques to inform us climate policy

description: Neha Patankar and university co-authors publish a study extending and applying robust optimisation to US energy-system planning under uncertain fuel prices and technology costs. The native abstract explains that uncertainty is considered within a single model run to derive a near-term hedging strategy. It reports a more diversified technology mix and lower expected costs and cost variability than the scenario that ignores uncertainty. These are study-specific model findings, not guaranteed policy outcomes. Zenodo supplies a Temoa robust-model ZIP freely under GPL 2.0. Coverage is the United States, while scenario horizons, regional detail and uncertainty bounds are not specified in the inspected metadata. The related Temoa record represents the general model family. A limitation is that the code archive was not opened and the numerical findings were not reproduced; the exact extension implementation and solver requirements remain unverified.
